comment: AppleParavirtGPU 25G241 (UUID 0CAE9E29-BC33-315D-82A7-A7D30E9B971E, __TEXT vmaddr 0x14898000) x86_64 inline BAR0 access sites patched by the live bridge. text_offset is relative to the __TEXT segment start (file offset 0). span is the number of original bytes overwritten by a near CALL plus NOP padding and must end on an instruction boundary. original is the exact expected byte sequence. continuation is the __TEXT offset where the site resumes. bar_offset is the absolute BAR0 register offset (Reims decodes (offset-0x1000)/4). base_slot is the offset, inside the stub frame, of the saved GPR that holds the BAR register base on entry. dest is the GPR the read result is written to. reproduce holds original instructions from the span that the stub re-executes after restoring flags (needed because the following instruction consumes the flags). Sites 4-6 complete the audit's patch_required list except the FIFO read cursor (0x100c), which is deliberately served from the shared page: it is polled in the guest's spin loop and must not sleep; the daemon publishes the device cursor every 80 us, so the shadow can only lag the device.
